text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The URA Finale comes to a close as a great success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sight of the competitors racing to claim the crown has touched the hearts of everyone in attendance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa takes the opportunity to express her deep gratitude, as well as to regale me with a passionate speech!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa takes the opportunity to express her deep gratitude!
